+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelPreservesCvss40BySource(t *testing.T) {
+	nvds := []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Descriptions: []cvedict.NvdDescription{{Value: "example vulnerability"}},
+		Cvss3:        []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss3: cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.5}}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.2, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "vendor@example.com", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.1, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}}
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel("CVE-2024-1234", nvds)
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d NVD contents, want 2: %#v", len(contents), contents)
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent)
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	for source, want := range map[string]struct {
+		score    float64
+		vector   string
+		severity string
+	}{
+		"nvd@nist.gov":       {8.2, "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", "HIGH"},
+		"vendor@example.com": {5.1, "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", "MEDIUM"},
+	} {
+		got, ok := bySource[source]
+		if !ok || got.Cvss40Score != want.score || got.Cvss40Vector != want.vector || got.Cvss40Severity != want.severity {
+			t.Errorf("source %q: got %#v, want CVSS 4.0 %#v", source, got, want)
+		}
+	}
+	if got := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"].Cvss3Score; got != 7.5 {
+		t.Errorf("CVSS 3 score lost when CVSS 4.0 uses same source: got %v", got)
+	}
+}
